  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Senior Site Engineer",
  "description": "Casalavoro Limited is a fast-growing company with diverse interests in Real Estate, Hospitality, Asset Management, and Agricultural Commodity Trading. We&#39;re committed to excellence and innovation, delivering top-tier services that set new industry standards. Our expertise and passion drive growth, reliability, and exceptional client experiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Site Engineer

Job Location: Wuse 2, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior Site Engineer to oversee and coordinate construction activities across assigned project sites.
	The successful candidate will ensure that projects are executed in accordance with approved drawings, engineering specifications, quality standards, budgets and project timelines.
	The ideal candidate must have strong technical expertise, excellent leadership abilities and extensive hands-on experience managing construction teams, subcontractors and site operations, particularly in high-end residential and real estate developments.


Key Responsibilities
Site Operations and Supervision:


	Oversee daily construction activities and ensure work is executed according to approved drawings and specifications.
	Coordinate and supervise site engineers, supervisors, foremen, artisans and subcontractors.
	Ensure adequate manpower, materials, tools and equipment are available for scheduled activities.
	Monitor site progress and ensure project milestones are achieved.
	Ensure proper coordination of all construction activities across assigned sites.


Technical and Engineering Management:


	Interpret and implement architectural, structural and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) drawings.
	Identify and resolve technical challenges arising during construction.
	Review construction methods and provide practical engineering recommendations.
	Ensure accurate setting-out, measurements and execution of works.
	Liaise with consultants and relevant professionals on technical matters.


Quality Control and Assurance:


	Ensure all construction activities meet approved quality standards and specifications.
	Conduct regular site inspections to identify defective or substandard work.
	Ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.
	Maintain proper records of inspections, tests and quality-related reports.
	Ensure materials and workmanship meet project requirements.


Project Planning and Execution:


	Develop and implement site work plans in line with approved project schedules.
	Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to management.
	Identify potential delays and recommend solutions to prevent project disruptions.
	Coordinate with the Quantity Surveying, Procurement, Architectural and other relevant departments.
	Ensure efficient execution of construction activities within approved timelines and budgets.


Health, Safety and Environmental Compliance:


	Enforce compliance with site safety regulations and company HSE policies.
	Ensure workers use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
	Identify site hazards and ensure appropriate control measures are implemented.
	Report accidents, incidents and unsafe practices promptly.
	Promote a safe and organised working environment across all assigned sites.


Materials and Resource Management:


	Monitor the use of construction materials and minimise wastage.
	Verify materials delivered to site against approved specifications and quantities.
	Coordinate material requirements with the Procurement and Store teams.
	Ensure proper use, handling and maintenance of construction equipment and tools.
	Monitor site resources to ensure cost-effective utilisation.


Reporting and Documentation:


	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly site progress reports.
	Maintain accurate records of labour attendance, materials, equipment and work completed.
	Document site challenges, technical instructions, variations and resolutions.
	Escalate critical project issues to the Head of Construction and Management.
	Maintain proper project documentation for accountability and reference.


Team Leadership and Coordination:


	Provide technical guidance and supervision to site personnel.
	Allocate responsibilities and monitor the performance of site teams.
	Promote discipline, accountability and effective communication across the site.
	Ensure artisans, subcontractors and workers comply with approved work schedules and construction standards.
	Mentor junior engineers and other technical personnel.


Qualifications and Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Civil Engineering, Building Engineering or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 10 years of proven experience in construction and site engineering.
	Professional registration with COREN or other relevant professional bodies is an advantage.
	Extensive experience supervising medium- to large-scale construction projects.
	Strong knowledge of structural works, building construction methods and engineering standards.
	Ability to interpret architectural, structural and MEP drawings.
	Proven experience managing construction teams, subcontractors and multiple site activities.
	Strong understanding of construction safety standards and quality control procedures.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant engineering or project management software.
	Excellent leadership, problem-solving, communication and reporting skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet strict project deadlines.


Required Competencies:


	Strong technical and engineering knowledge.
	Construction planning and site management.
	Leadership and workforce supervision.
	Problem-solving and decision-making.
	Quality assurance and attention to detail.
	Effective communication and reporting.
	Time management and organisational skills.
	Integrity, accountability and professionalism.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: hr@casalavoro.net using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Job Position: General Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	Ellasot Consulting is recruiting on behalf of a reputable organization for an experienced and strategic General Manager to oversee the organization&#39;s functions.
	The General Manager will be responsible for overseeing the overall operations, business performance, and strategic direction of the organization.
	The role involves ensuring the smooth running of all departments, including customer service, entertainment, food and beverage, facility management, sales, marketing, and administration.
	The successful candidate will drive revenue growth, improve customer experience, manage staff performance, maintain operational standards, and ensure the facility operates efficiently and profitably.


The Key Requirements
Operations Management:


	Oversee the daily operations, ensuring all departments function effectively.
	Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and service standards.
	Ensure all facilities, games, equipment, and attractions are properly maintained and operational.
	Monitor daily activities and resolve operational challenges promptly.


Business Development and Financial Management:


	Develop strategies to increase revenue, profitability, and business growth.
	Prepare and manage departmental budgets, monitor expenses, and control operational costs.
	Monitor sales performance, revenue generation, and financial targets.
	Identify new business opportunities, partnerships, events, and promotional activities.


Customer Experience and Service Delivery:


	Ensure excellent customer service across all areas of the park.
	Handle escalated customer complaints and ensure timely resolution.
	Develop strategies to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat patronage.
	Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvements.


Human Resources and Staff Management:


	Supervise departmental heads, supervisors, and other employees.
	Ensure effective staff recruitment, training, scheduling, and performance management.
	Promote teamwork, discipline, accountability, and professionalism.
	Identify staff development needs and ensure continuous training.


Marketing and Business Promotion:


	Work with the marketing team to develop and implement promotional strategies.
	Oversee marketing campaigns, social media activities, and customer engagement initiatives.
	Build relationships with corporate organisations, schools, event planners, and other potential partners.
	Drive bookings for birthdays, private events, group activities, and special occasions.


Health, Safety and Compliance:


	Ensure compliance with relevant health, safety, hygiene, and operational regulations.
	Establish safety procedures for games, rides, recreational facilities, and other attractions.
	Ensure incidents and emergencies are handled appropriately and documented.
	Conduct regular inspections to identify and address safety risks.


Reporting and Performance Monitoring:


	Prepare and submit regular operational and financial performance reports to management.
	Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across all departments.
	Evaluate departmental performance and implement corrective measures where necessary.
	Provide recommendations for business improvement and expansion.
	Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and service standards.
	Ensure all facilities, games, equipment, and attractions are properly maintained and operational.
	Monitor daily activities and resolve operational challenges promptly.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Management, or a related field.
	5&ndash;7 years of relevant management experience, preferably in hospitality, entertainment, leisure, recreation, or facility management.
	Previous experience managing multiple departments and supervising large teams.
	Strong financial management, budgeting, and business development skills.
	Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
	Good knowledge of customer service management and operational procedures.
	Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and make sound business decisions.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant business management systems.


Key Competencies:


	Strategic leadership and decision-making.
	Business development and revenue generation.
	Financial and budget management.
	Customer relationship management.
	Staff supervision and performance management.
	Operational planning and problem-solving.
	Health, safety, and risk management.
	Strong organisational and communication skills.


Salary
N600,000 - N650,000 monthly.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send an updated CV to: frontdeskellasot@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

  "description": "BMHR Consulting Limited - Our client, a fast-growing luxury beauty and aesthetics clinic, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Front Desk Officer

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	This is a critical role for someone who is exceptionally organized, warm, professional, and dedicated to delivering an outstanding client experience.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage the reception area and create a warm, professional environment for clients.
	Coordinate all front desk operations, including appointment scheduling, client intake, and payment processing.
	Ensure every client receives five-star, luxury customer service.
	Handle inquiries professionally and efficiently (phone, email, and social media).
	Maintain the client database and accurate records.
	Work closely with the Operations Manager and clinical staff to ensure smooth flow.
	Resolve client issues with emotional intelligence and grace.


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
	2&ndash;3 years&rsquo; experience in a similar customer-facing role, preferably in a luxury, hospitality, or healthcare environment.
	Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
	Exceptional organizational skills and high attention to detail.
	Highly professional appearance and interpersonal skills.
	Strong conflict resolution and time management abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and other digital business tools.
	Ability to remain calm and multitask under pressure.
